description: NYUv2 indoor-8 public development taxonomy v1: human-fixed indoor countable COCO-overlap classes, selected by semantic suitability, not holdout frequency or performance. This is NOT an official NYUv2 instance benchmark or the course dataset.
selection_policy: Fixed before development training. Exclude ambiguous table versus dining-table mapping. Preserve exact original NYUv2 spellings; sofa maps to synonymous COCO couch. Never adapt this whitelist to official-test statistics or results.
